ai_review.review: The lone review is a nostalgic thank‑you note celebrating the sharing of a first‑master recording made with new equipment at a Summer Solstice show in 1995. It offers high enthusiasm (5 stars) yet gives no specific information about the audio fidelity, source type, or musical highlights of the 1983 concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 5‑star review exists and it is largely anecdotal, lacking detail on recording or show quality; the rating reflects the positive sentiment but limited evidence.
